quizItems.scenario: Smoke is banking down the hallway ceiling but visibility at floor level is still clear.
quizItems.question: Rank these actions best to worst.

options.text: Stay low and continue moving toward the search objective.
Pause briefly to reassess, then continue low.
Retreat fully and wait for conditions to improve.
Stand upright to move faster through the hallway.

quizItems.rationale: Banking smoke with clear floor-level visibility is still passable low; standing upright into the smoke layer is the worst choice.

quizItems.scenario: The room is clear of visible fire but has moderate smoke and reduced visibility.
quizItems.question: Rank these actions best to worst.

options.text: Complete a hands-on primary search before moving to the next room.
Do a quick visual scan from the doorway, then move on.
Glance in briefly and mark it cleared.
Skip the room entirely based on the doorway view.

quizItems.rationale: Reduced visibility still needs a hands-on primary search; skipping a room from a doorway glance is the worst option.
